## 보관 원문

> # Nitrogen Control in Electric Arc Furnace Steelmaking by DRI
>
> The 2004 AISI/USDOE technical report describes nitrogen as a barrier to
> high-quality EAF steel. In the report's comparison, BOF steel contained about
> 30-40 ppm N and EAF steel about 70-100 ppm N.
>
> Nitrogen can enter with the charge, through contact between air and molten
> steel, and through ionized nitrogen in the arc region. Reported plant control
> measures include blending lower-nitrogen DRI, maintaining foamy slag and good
> tapping practice, and generating carbon-monoxide bubbles that rinse dissolved
> nitrogen. Vacuum treatment is an established secondary-refining route, but
> adds cost, time, and equipment and has process limitations.
>
> The project tested injection of carbon- and oxygen-bearing DRI fines to create
> fine CO bubbles in molten steel. The pilot-scale injections were unsuccessful,
> although full-scale data were obtained and recommendations were developed.
> The report therefore does not establish DRI-fines injection as a demonstrated
> commercial denitrogenation solution.
>
